She says:

"This perfume smells absolutely gorgeous! It has such a luxurious, elegant scent that feels perfect for everyday wear or a special night out. And right now, we’ve got a limited-time deal in the livestream for just $29—it’s honestly such a steal!"

The scene is styled like a modern premium e-commerce livestream interface. There are floating chat comments on the left, gift animations including hearts, fireworks, and virtual gifts, and a stylish product information card on the right showing the perfume name, price "$29", and a purchase button. The livestream viewer count displays "100K+" viewers.

Camera shot: medium close-up, soft flattering lighting, clean premium beauty-commercial look, with a subtle cinematic camera push-in movement.

Overall style: high-end luxury beauty advertising inspired by Japanese commercial visuals, warm elegant atmosphere, polished and engaging livestream presentation, premium product cinematography.

그녀는 이렇게 말한다:

"This perfume smells absolutely gorgeous! It has such a luxurious, elegant scent that feels perfect for everyday wear or a special night out. And right now, we’ve got a limited-time deal in the livestream for just $29—it’s honestly such a steal!"

카메라 샷: 미디엄 클로즈업, 부드럽고 호감 가는 조명, 깔끔한 프리미엄 뷰티 광고 느낌, 은은한 시네마틱 카메라 푸시인 움직임.

전체 스타일: 일본 상업 광고 비주얼에서 영감을 받은 하이엔드 럭셔리 뷰티 광고, 따뜻하고 우아한 분위기, 세련되고 몰입감 있는 라이브스트림 प्रस्त현, 프리미엄 제품 시네마토그래피.
